notes.title: 小更新
notes.content:
先跟支持我的朋友們說聲抱歉
因為個人因素，隔了這麼久才更新
在這段期間我也學習了很多關於遊戲製作的相關知識
希望能帶給玩家更好的體驗

這次更新了回饋中提到的"壽司出現太混亂"的問題，現在應該會比之前還容易一些
新增了音量設定
調整存檔與讀檔的格式

First of all, I want to say sorry to my friends who support me.
Due to personal reasons, it took so long to update.
During this period, I also learned a lot about game production.
I hope to bring players a better experience

This update addresses the issue of "sushi is too confusing" mentioned in the feedback. It should be easier now than before.
Added volume setting
Adjust the format of saving and loading files

notes.title: Add 3 save slots
notes.content:
Some players asked me to add some S&L slots.

So I added them, hope you enjoy!

Update your game!

notes.title: Finally
notes.content:
Learning the programming language until now, finally have the opportunity to complete my game and sell it publicly

Thank you for your support, encouragement and assistance from many of your friends.

I also hope that after you have played, give me relevant advice.

That I can make more games for you in the future.
